root_causes: The SM34 aerospace runtime imported scipy.linalg, but scipy was absent from the original Windows dependency profile.
The SM34 endurance runtime imported the Unix-only resource module and attempted directory fsync behavior unsupported by Windows.

correction.windows_directory_fsync: safely skipped while file fsync and atomic replace remain enabled

windows_recovery: Extract the V2 corrected package and run SETUP_WINDOWS.bat again. The existing dependency downloads do not need Rust or MSVC, and the runtime no longer requires the Unix-only resource module.
